lora.title: On this machine (recommended)
lora.intro: Train a small LoRA adapter on your own notes, on this Mac or NVIDIA computer, and use it in Ollama. Nothing is uploaded: Lumen exports the training data and a script; you run the script.
lora.exported: lumen-lora.zip: {notes} notes · {train} training samples · {valid} validation · {heldOut} held-out notes for the style check
lora.tooLittle: Not enough writing to train on ({notes} usable notes): pick a folder with more notes of a few paragraphs.
lora.next.mac: Unzip lumen-lora.zip and run: bash train-mac.sh — it trains on Mistral 7B (Apache-2.0) with MLX, fuses the adapter to GGUF and adds “lumen-style” to Ollama.
lora.next.nvidia: Unzip lumen-lora.zip and run: bash train-nvidia.sh — it trains a LoRA with PEFT (Unsloth core, Apache-2.0), converts it with llama.cpp and adds “lumen-style” to Ollama.
